metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds Field's call, two quires laid by, and the letter still waiting for the carrier.

yesterday: Harrison will print Venus again, smaller, in octavo. There is not a penny in it for you. You were glad to be thought portable.
Two quires of Rochelle crown are to be laid by at fourpence halfpenny the quire.
Your father, last you know, is mending. Tomorrow's carrier is the next word.
The Sunday letter is still folded. It goes with Hobbins.
